ideas.title: The Use of Ethics Probes as a Means of Targeting Political Enemies
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of ethics probes as a means of targeting political enemies, using the Lindsey Halligan investigation as a case study
questions: What is the extent of the use of ethics probes as a means of targeting political enemies?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant pattern of abuse of power and corruption. By investigating the use of ethics probes as a means of targeting political enemies, we may be able to shed light on a larger issue that has significant implications for democracy and the rule of law.
